subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE PROHIBITION BY THE AUTHORITIES OF THE
text:

A)UUUU B)2610010723 C)2701012359 EST
E)AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE PROHIBITION BY THE AUTHORITIES OF THE
REPUBLIC OF SLOVAKIA STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED,
CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND ALL AIR CARRIERS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR
CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION ARE FORBIDDEN TO ENTRY, EXIT OR OVERFLY THE SLOVAKIAN
AIRSPACE PURSUANT TO AIRAC AIP SUP 3/23,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM
THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE
CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF SLOVAKIA AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AOC
ISSUED BY THE AUTHORITIES OF SLOVAKIA ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT
OR OVERFLY THE AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR ACFT
IN AN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN FLIGHTS, AMBULANCE FLIGHTS AND OTHERS
POSSESSING A SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLT GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR
TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
